tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: Military Order of the World Wars (in this chapter, the “corporation”), a nonprofit corporation incorporated in the District of Columbia, is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Expiration of Charter.—
tree.text: The charter granted by this chapter expires if the corporation fails to comply with any provision of—

children.text: its bylaws or articles of incorporation;
the laws of the District of Columbia that apply to corporations such as the corporation recognized under this chapter.
